terms.definition: An account is your personal space on the NEAR blockchain, like a digital identity, where you can hold tokens, interact with apps, and manage your assets securely.
A named account is a user-friendly account with a readable name, such as 'alice.near', making it easy to remember and share, unlike a random string of characters.
A sub-account is an account created under a main account, acting like a folder for organizing projects or permissions, such as 'app.alice.near' under 'alice.near'.
An access key is a digital key that grants permission to access your NEAR account, allowing actions like signing transactions or using apps, similar to a password for your account.
A function-call key is a limited access key that only allows calling specific functions in a smart contract, reducing risk by restricting what actions can be performed.
Gas is a small fee paid in NEAR tokens to process transactions or run smart contracts, covering the computational work needed on the blockchain network.
Storage staking is the practice of locking up a small amount of NEAR tokens to pay for storing data on the blockchain, like saving files or account information.
A yoctoNEAR is the smallest possible unit of NEAR token, much like a cent is to a dollar, used for precise calculations and very small transactions.
Testnet is a practice version of the NEAR blockchain where you can try out apps and transactions without using real money, using test tokens instead.
A transaction hash is a unique code that identifies a specific transaction on the blockchain, serving as a receipt you can use to track or verify it.

sections.glossary: Below are 10 essential NEAR terms defined clearly for everyday use. They cover basics like accounts, keys, costs, and transaction details you'll encounter when interacting with NEAR dApps.
sections.intro: Welcome to this plain-language glossary for NEAR! If you're new to NEAR and using a dApp's wallet login, these definitions will help you understand key terms without technical jargon. Each term is explained in one or two simple sentences to make your experience smoother and more informed.
